description: This file defines APIs, enums, structures, and constants related to WiFi configuration and management within the COSA Data Model Library, including security modes, frequency bands, channel bandwidths, and related functions.

methods.name: CosaDmlWiFiGetEnableRadiusGreylist
methods.description: Retrieves whether the Radius Greylist is enabled.

methods.name: CosaDmlWiFiSetEnableRadiusGreylist
methods.description: Sets the status of Radius Greylist.

methods.name: CosaDmlWiFiGetForceDisableWiFiRadio
methods.description: Checks if WiFi radio is forcibly disabled.

methods.name: CosaWiFiDmlGetWPA3TransitionRFC
methods.description: Retrieves the WPA3 transition RFC status.

methods.name: txRateStrToUint
methods.description: Converts a string representation of data rate to its numeric value.

methods.name: freqBandStrToEnum
methods.description: Converts frequency band string to enum.

methods.name: wifiStdStrToEnum
methods.description: Converts WiFi standard string to enum.

methods.name: regDomainStrToEnum
methods.description: Converts regulatory domain string to enum.

methods.name: guardIntervalDmlEnumtoHalEnum
methods.description: Converts guard interval enum from DML to HAL representation.

methods.name: operChanBandwidthDmlEnumtoHalEnum
methods.description: Converts operational channel bandwidth enum from DML to HAL.

methods.name: getSecurityTypeFromString
methods.description: Gets security type enum from security name string.

methods.name: AssociatedDevice_callback_register
methods.description: Registers callback for associated device events.

methods.name: decode_json_obj
methods.description: Decodes JSON object from bus handle.
